senses.en: the person speaking, when someone does something to them

ex.en: Can you help me with my bag?
ex.zh: 你能帮我拿一下包吗？

ex.en: The teacher gave me a book.
ex.zh: 老师给了我一本书。

tip: me 是 I 的宾格，作动词/介词的宾语。
scene: A friend helping another carry a heavy school bag.

senses.en: used to say something is possible

ex.en: She might come to the party, but she's not sure.
ex.zh: 她可能会来参加聚会，但还不确定。

ex.en: It might snow tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天可能会下雪。

tip: might 表示可能性，比 may 更不确定。
scene: A girl looking at a cloudy sky wondering if it might snow.

senses.en: something that belongs to me

ex.en: This bicycle is mine, not yours.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车是我的，不是你的。

ex.en: My phone is black and hers is white. Wait, mine is blue.
ex.zh: 我的手机是黑色的，她的是白色的。等等，我的是蓝色的。

tip: mine 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: A blue bicycle standing in front of a school bike rack.

senses.en: water that comes from underground with minerals in it

ex.en: Can I have a bottle of mineral water, please?
ex.zh: 请给我一瓶矿泉水。

ex.en: He drinks mineral water instead of soft drinks.
ex.zh: 他喝矿泉水而不是软饮料。

col: a bottle of mineral water｜一瓶矿泉水
tip: mineral water 指天然矿泉水；sparkling water 是气泡水。
scene: A bottle of mineral water with droplets on it in a picnic basket.

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

ex.en: He rides his motorbike to work every day.
ex.zh: 他每天骑摩托车上班。

ex.en: The motorbike stopped in front of the café.
ex.zh: 摩托车停在咖啡馆前面。

tip: motorbike 是英式口语说法；motorcycle 更正式。
scene: A red motorbike parked on a street with a helmet on the seat.

senses.en: title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr Brown is our new English teacher.
ex.zh: 布朗先生是我们新的英语老师。

ex.en: Good morning, Mr Smith.
ex.zh: 早上好，史密斯先生。

tip: Mr 用于男性姓氏前；Mrs 用于已婚女性，Ms 用于女性（不限婚否）。
scene: A friendly male teacher standing at a classroom door with books.

senses.zh: 夫人；太太（已婚女性称谓）
senses.en: title used before a married woman's surname

ex.en: Mrs Jones lives next door to us.
ex.zh: 琼斯太太住在我们隔壁。

ex.en: Hello, Mrs Green. How are you today?
ex.zh: 你好，格林太太，你今天好吗？

tip: Mrs 用于已婚女性姓氏前；不确定婚否用 Ms。
scene: A friendly woman in a garden waving to neighbours over a fence.

senses.zh: 女士（女性称谓，不限婚否）
senses.en: title used before a woman's surname

ex.en: Ms Lee is the new manager of the shop.
ex.zh: 李女士是这家店的新经理。

ex.en: Please address the letter to Ms Chen.
ex.zh: 请把信寄给陈女士。

tip: Ms 不表明婚否，是现代更常用的女性称谓。
scene: A professional woman with a nameplate reading Ms Lee at an office desk.

senses.en: very close to something, beside it

ex.en: The bank is next to the supermarket.
ex.zh: 银行紧挨着超市。

ex.en: She sat next to me in the cinema.
ex.zh: 她在电影院里坐在我旁边。

tip: next to 表示“紧挨着”；near 是“附近”，距离更远。
scene: A bank building standing right beside a supermarket.

senses.en: not any; used to say no

ex.en: There is no milk in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

ex.en: 'Are you coming?' 'No, I'm busy.'
ex.zh: “你来吗？”“不，我很忙。”

tip: no + 名词表示“没有…”；回答疑问句用 yes/no。
scene: An open fridge with an empty milk carton inside.

senses.en: not anybody

ex.en: No one was in the classroom after school.
ex.zh: 放学后教室里没有人。

ex.en: She called, but no one answered.
ex.zh: 她打了电话，但没人接。

tip: no one 和 nobody 同义，都是“没有人”；谓语用单数。
scene: An empty classroom with desks and chairs but no students.

senses.en: used to make a word or sentence negative

ex.en: I am not hungry right now.
ex.zh: 我现在不饿。

ex.en: This is not my umbrella.
ex.zh: 这不是我的伞。

tip: not 用于构成否定；can not 可缩为 can't，is not 缩为 isn't。
scene: A girl shaking her head at a plate of food, saying she's not hungry.

senses.en: used to show possession or connection

ex.en: This is a photo of my family.
ex.zh: 这是一张我全家的照片。

ex.en: The door of the shop is open.
ex.zh: 商店的门开着。

tip: of 表示所属关系或数量；a glass of water 一杯水。
scene: A photo frame showing a family picture on a shelf.

senses.en: used to show surprise, understanding or interest

ex.en: Oh, I didn't know you were here!
ex.zh: 哦，我不知道你在这里！

ex.en: Oh, I see. Thank you for explaining.
ex.zh: 哦，我明白了。谢谢你解释。

tip: oh 是语气词，表达惊讶、顿悟等情绪。
scene: A girl looking surprised with her hand near her mouth saying oh.

senses.en: relating to the Olympic Games

ex.en: She watched the Olympic Games on TV.
ex.zh: 她在电视上观看奥运会。

ex.en: The Olympic torch arrived in the city.
ex.zh: 奥运圣火到达了这座城市。

tip: the Olympic Games 是“奥运会”，也常说 the Olympics。
scene: An Olympic torch with five colourful rings symbol on a stadium.

senses.en: eggs beaten and cooked flat in a pan

ex.en: She made a cheese omelette for breakfast.
ex.zh: 她做了奶酪煎蛋卷当早餐。

ex.en: I'd like an omelette with mushrooms, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一份蘑菇煎蛋卷。

tip: omelette 是摊开的煎蛋饼，可加奶酪、蔬菜等。
scene: A golden omelette with cheese on a plate on a breakfast table.

senses.en: no more than; alone in a group

ex.en: I have only one ticket left.
ex.zh: 我只剩一张票了。

ex.en: She is the only girl in the team.
ex.zh: 她是队里唯一的女孩。

tip: only 作副词表示“仅仅”，作形容词表示“唯一的”。
scene: A single ticket lying on an empty table.

senses.en: something that belongs to us

ex.en: This garden is ours.
ex.zh: 这个花园是我们的。

ex.en: Their house is bigger than ours.
ex.zh: 他们的房子比我们的大。

tip: ours 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: Two children playing in their own garden with a swing.

senses.en: from inside to outside

ex.en: She took a book out of her bag.
ex.zh: 她从包里拿出一本书。

ex.en: He ran out of the room in a hurry.
ex.zh: 他匆忙跑出房间。

tip: out of 表示“从…出来”；反义词是 into（进入）。
scene: A girl taking a book out of her school bag at a desk.

senses.en: to put things into a bag or box

ex.en: I need to pack my suitcase for the trip.
ex.zh: 我需要为旅行收拾行李箱。

ex.en: She packed some sandwiches for lunch.
ex.zh: 她打包了几个三明治当午餐。

tip: pack 是“收拾打包”；反义词 unpack 是“打开行李”。
scene: An open suitcase on a bed with clothes being packed into it.

senses.en: a piece of something, or a role in a play

ex.en: This is the best part of the film.
ex.zh: 这是电影最好的部分。

ex.en: She played the main part in the school play.
ex.zh: 她在学校演出中扮演主角。

tip: take part in 是“参加活动”；play a part 是“扮演角色”。
scene: A stage with a girl in a costume taking a bow in the spotlight.

senses.en: beyond a place; time before now

ex.en: It's half past two.
ex.zh: 现在两点半。

ex.en: We walked past the library on the way home.
ex.zh: 回家路上我们经过了图书馆。

tip: past 指时间“过了”；half past five 是五点半。
scene: A clock showing half past two on a classroom wall.

senses.en: small British money; 100 pence in a pound

ex.en: The sweets cost fifty pence.
ex.zh: 这些糖果五十便士。

ex.en: I have one pound and twenty pence.
ex.zh: 我有一英镑二十便士。

tip: pence 是 penny 的复数（金额时用），如 20 pence。
scene: A handful of British coins on a shop counter.

senses.en: a small box or bag for pens and pencils

ex.en: My pencil case has two pens and three pencils.
ex.zh: 我的文具盒里有两支钢笔和三支铅笔。

ex.en: Don't forget your pencil case for the exam.
ex.zh: 考试别忘了带文具盒。

tip: pencil case 是装笔的文具盒/袋。
scene: An open pencil case with pens, pencils and an eraser on a desk.

senses.en: a friend you write letters to but may never meet

ex.en: I have a penfriend in Australia.
ex.zh: 我有一个澳大利亚的笔友。

ex.en: She wrote a letter to her penfriend in English.
ex.zh: 她用英语给笔友写了一封信。

tip: penfriend 是英式说法，pen pal 是美式说法。
scene: A girl writing a letter at a desk with a world map behind her.

senses.en: a place where you buy petrol for cars

ex.en: We stopped at a petrol station to fill the car.
ex.zh: 我们在加油站停车加油。

ex.en: The petrol station is open all night.
ex.zh: 这家加油站通宵营业。

tip: petrol station 是英式说法；美式说 gas station。
scene: A car being filled with fuel at a petrol station with a price sign.

senses.en: a person who takes photos as a job or hobby

ex.en: The photographer took our class photo.
ex.zh: 摄影师给我们拍了班级合影。

ex.en: She wants to be a nature photographer.
ex.zh: 她想成为一名自然摄影师。

tip: photographer 是“摄影师”；photography 是“摄影（艺术）”。
scene: A photographer with a camera taking photos of flowers in a park.

senses.en: to lift something up, or to collect someone

ex.en: Please pick up the litter and put it in the bin.
ex.zh: 请捡起垃圾放进垃圾桶。

ex.en: Mum will pick me up after school.
ex.zh: 妈妈放学后来接我。

tip: pick up 有多种意思：捡起、接人、学会（pick up a language）。
scene: A child picking up a piece of paper and putting it in a bin.

senses.en: a large white bear that lives in the Arctic

ex.en: Polar bears live in very cold places.
ex.zh: 北极熊生活在非常寒冷的地方。

ex.en: We saw a polar bear on the documentary.
ex.zh: 我们在纪录片里看到了一只北极熊。

tip: polar bear 是北极熊，生活在北极，毛是白色的。
scene: A white polar bear walking on snowy ice with mountains behind.

senses.en: a car used by the police

ex.en: A police car drove past with its lights flashing.
ex.zh: 一辆警车闪着灯开了过去。

ex.en: The police car stopped outside the bank.
ex.zh: 警车停在银行外面。

tip: police car 是警车，配有警灯和警报器。
scene: A white and blue police car with flashing lights on a street.

senses.en: a member of the police force

ex.en: The police officer helped the lost child.
ex.zh: 警察帮助了迷路的孩子。

ex.en: Ask a police officer if you need directions.
ex.zh: 需要问路可以找警察。

tip: police officer 是不分性别的说法；policeman 是男警。
scene: A police officer in uniform helping a lost child on a street.

senses.en: the building where police officers work

ex.en: The police station is near the town hall.
ex.zh: 警察局在市政厅附近。

ex.en: He went to the police station to report the theft.
ex.zh: 他去警察局报案失窃。

tip: police station 是警察办公的建筑；报案说 report 或 report a crime。
scene: A police station building with a blue sign and police car outside.

senses.en: to get dressed or put something on your body

ex.en: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
ex.zh: 穿上外套，外面很冷。

ex.en: She put on her glasses to read.
ex.zh: 她戴上眼镜看书。

tip: put on 是“穿上/戴上”；反义短语是 take off（脱下）。
scene: A child putting on a warm coat by the front door.

senses.en: the sport of riding a horse

ex.en: She goes riding every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 她每周六早上去骑马。

ex.en: Riding is a popular sport in the countryside.
ex.zh: 骑马是乡村很受欢迎的运动。

tip: riding 指骑马运动；horse-riding 也是常见说法。
scene: A girl riding a brown horse across a green field.

senses.en: the hand on the right side of your body

ex.en: She writes with her right hand.
ex.zh: 她用右手写字。

ex.en: Hold the cup in your right hand.
ex.zh: 用右手拿着杯子。

tip: right hand 是右手；反义 left hand 左手。
scene: A child raising their right hand in class.

senses.en: feeling unhappy

ex.en: She felt sad when her friend moved away.
ex.zh: 朋友搬走时她很难过。

ex.en: The sad film made everyone cry.
ex.zh: 这部悲伤的电影让大家都哭了。

tip: sad 形容悲伤；名词 sadness 悲伤，副词 sadly 悲伤地。
scene: A girl sitting alone on a bench looking down with a sad face.

senses.en: a child who goes to school

ex.en: Every schoolchild in the town got a free book.
ex.zh: 镇上的每个学童都得到了一本免费的书。

ex.en: The schoolchildren walked to the museum in a line.
ex.zh: 小学生们排着队走去博物馆。

tip: schoolchild 复数 schoolchildren；pupil 也指学生。
scene: Schoolchildren in uniform walking in a line with backpacks.

senses.en: a female person or animal already mentioned

ex.en: She is my sister.
ex.zh: 她是我妹妹。

ex.en: Where is Anna? She is in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 安娜在哪？她在厨房里。

tip: she 是主格；宾格 her，物主代词 hers。
scene: A girl waving from a kitchen doorway as someone asks where she is.

senses.en: a person who works in a shop helping customers

ex.en: The shop assistant helped me find the right size.
ex.zh: 店员帮我找到了合适的尺码。

ex.en: Ask the shop assistant how much this costs.
ex.zh: 问问店员这个多少钱。

tip: shop assistant 是英式说法，指商店里的服务员。
scene: A shop assistant in a uniform helping a customer at a counter.

senses.en: a person who is shopping

ex.en: The shoppers filled the supermarket on Saturday.
ex.zh: 周六超市里挤满了购物者。

ex.en: Shoppers can park free for two hours.
ex.zh: 购物者可免费停车两小时。

tip: shopper 指正在购物的人；customer 是顾客。
scene: A shopper with carrier bags walking through a busy supermarket.

senses.en: a large building with many shops

ex.en: We spent the afternoon at the shopping centre.
ex.zh: 我们在购物中心待了一下午。

ex.en: The new shopping centre has a cinema inside.
ex.zh: 新购物中心里面有一家电影院。

tip: shopping centre 是英式说法；美式常说 shopping mall。
scene: A modern shopping centre with glass walls and people carrying bags.

senses.en: the activity of making music with your voice

ex.en: Singing in the choir makes her happy.
ex.zh: 在合唱团唱歌让她很开心。

ex.en: We heard beautiful singing from the music room.
ex.zh: 我们听到音乐教室传来美妙的歌声。

tip: singing 是名词“唱歌”；singer 是歌手。
scene: A girl singing on a small stage with a microphone.

senses.en: to move to a sitting position

ex.en: Please sit down and open your books.
ex.zh: 请坐下，打开课本。

ex.en: He sat down next to his friend on the bench.
ex.zh: 他坐在长椅上朋友旁边。

tip: sit down 是“坐下”的动作；反义 stand up（起立）。
scene: Students sitting down at their desks in a classroom.

senses.en: a room in a house for relaxing and entertaining

ex.en: We sat in the sitting room and chatted.
ex.zh: 我们坐在客厅里聊天。

ex.en: The sitting room is at the front of the house.
ex.zh: 客厅在房子的前面。

tip: sitting room 与 living room 同义，是客厅。
scene: A bright sitting room with armchairs, a lamp and a rug.

senses.en: the sport of moving on skates

ex.en: Skating on the frozen lake is great fun.
ex.zh: 在结冰的湖面上滑冰很好玩。

ex.en: She learned skating when she was six.
ex.zh: 她六岁就学会了滑冰。

tip: skating 指溜冰运动；ice skating 特指滑冰。
scene: A girl skating gracefully on an outdoor ice rink.

senses.en: a small animal with a shell that moves very slowly

ex.en: The snail crawled slowly across the path.
ex.zh: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过小路。

ex.en: We found a snail in the garden after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后我们在花园里发现了一只蜗牛。

tip: snail 蜗牛以“慢”著称；slippery as a snail 之类的习语少见，记住词义即可。
scene: A snail with its shell crawling across a green leaf.

senses.en: a board you stand on to slide down snow

ex.en: He rides his snowboard down the mountain.
ex.zh: 他踩着滑雪板从山上滑下来。

ex.en: My new snowboard is blue and white.
ex.zh: 我的新滑雪板是蓝白色的。

tip: snowboard 是滑雪板；运动本身叫 snowboarding。
scene: A snowboard standing upright in the snow on a ski slope.

senses.en: websites and apps where people share things online

ex.en: She shares photos of her dog on social media.
ex.zh: 她在社交媒体上分享她的狗的照片。

ex.en: Social media helps us keep in touch with friends.
ex.zh: 社交媒体帮助我们和朋友保持联系。

tip: social media 是社交媒体，如微博、微信朋友圈等平台。
scene: A smartphone showing social media posts with hearts and comments.

senses.en: a piece of music with words

ex.en: This song is my favourite at the moment.
ex.zh: 这首歌是我现在最喜欢的。

ex.en: They sang a happy song at the party.
ex.zh: 他们在聚会上唱了一首欢快的歌。

tip: song 是“歌曲”；sing a song 是“唱歌”。
scene: A music note floating over a guitar on a stage.

senses.en: a building where people play sports and exercise

ex.en: We play badminton at the sports centre.
ex.zh: 我们在体育中心打羽毛球。

ex.en: The sports centre has a swimming pool and a gym.
ex.zh: 体育中心有游泳池和健身房。

tip: sports centre 是运动场馆设施，如游泳馆、健身房。
scene: A large sports centre building with people entering with sports bags.

senses.en: pain in your stomach

ex.en: I ate too much and now I have a stomach ache.
ex.zh: 我吃太多，现在肚子疼。

ex.en: She stayed home because of a stomach ache.
ex.zh: 她因为肚子疼待在家里。

tip: stomach ache 是胃/肚子疼；earache 耳朵疼，toothache 牙疼。
scene: A child holding their stomach and sitting on a sofa, looking uncomfortable.

senses.en: the act of learning, or work at school or university

ex.en: Her studies are going well this term.
ex.zh: 这学期她的学业进展顺利。

ex.en: He gave up his studies to work abroad.
ex.zh: 他放弃学业去国外工作。

tip: studies 常用复数表示“学业/学习”；单数 study 是学习行为。
scene: A desk with open books and a laptop, a student studying hard.

senses.en: a long board used for surfing on waves

ex.en: He carried his surfboard to the beach.
ex.zh: 他把冲浪板带到海滩。

ex.en: The surfboard floats on the water easily.
ex.zh: 冲浪板很容易浮在水上。

tip: surfboard 是冲浪板；surfing 是冲浪运动。
scene: A colourful surfboard standing in the sand at a sunny beach.

senses.en: the sport of riding waves on a surfboard

ex.en: Surfboarding is popular at the seaside.
ex.zh: 海边很流行冲浪。

ex.en: She practises surfboarding every summer.
ex.zh: 她每年夏天练习冲浪。

tip: surfboarding 与 surfing 都指冲浪运动。
scene: A surfer riding a big wave on a surfboard at the beach.

senses.en: a place filled with water for swimming

ex.en: We go to the swimming pool every Friday.
ex.zh: 我们每周五去游泳池。

ex.en: The hotel has a big outdoor swimming pool.
ex.zh: 这家酒店有一个很大的室外游泳池。

tip: swimming pool 是游泳池；go swimming 是去游泳。
scene: A blue swimming pool with lanes and people swimming.

senses.en: a piece of clothing worn for swimming

ex.en: She packed her swimsuit for the holiday.
ex.zh: 她把泳衣装进行李去度假。

ex.en: This swimsuit is perfect for the beach.
ex.zh: 这件泳衣很适合去海滩。

tip: swimsuit 是泳衣；男士泳裤说 swimming trunks。
scene: A bright swimsuit hanging on a line by a sunny pool.

senses.en: a game where players hit a small ball over a net on a table

ex.en: We play table tennis in the school hall.
ex.zh: 我们在学校大厅里打乒乓球。

ex.en: Table tennis is a fast and exciting game.
ex.zh: 乒乓球是一项快速刺激的运动。

tip: table tennis 即乒乓球，也叫 ping-pong。
scene: Two players playing table tennis with paddles and a small white ball.

senses.en: to leave the ground, or to remove clothes

ex.en: The plane took off at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 飞机九点起飞。

ex.en: Please take off your shoes before entering.
ex.zh: 进入前请脱鞋。

tip: take off 指飞机“起飞”或脱衣“脱下”；反义 put on。
scene: An aeroplane taking off from a runway into the sky.

senses.en: to join in an activity or event

ex.en: All the students took part in the sports day.
ex.zh: 所有学生都参加了运动会。

ex.en: Would you like to take part in the competition?
ex.zh: 你想参加比赛吗？

tip: take part in 是“参加活动”；join 是“加入组织”。
scene: Students running in a race on a school sports day.

senses.en: a person who plays tennis

ex.en: She is a promising young tennis player.
ex.zh: 她是一名有前途的年轻网球运动员。

ex.en: The tennis player served the ball very fast.
ex.zh: 这名网球运动员发球很快。

tip: tennis player 是网球选手；play tennis 是打网球。
scene: A tennis player in white hitting a ball on a court.

senses.en: a short written message sent by phone

ex.en: She sent me a text message to say she was late.
ex.zh: 她发短信告诉我她要迟到了。

ex.en: I got a text message from my mum.
ex.zh: 我收到妈妈的一条短信。

tip: text message 是短信；send a text 是发短信。
scene: A phone screen showing a short text message conversation.

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想感谢你的帮助。

ex.en: She thanked the teacher for the present.
ex.zh: 她感谢老师送的礼物。

tip: thank sb for sth 是“为某事感谢某人”；thank you 是谢谢。
scene: A student thanking a teacher and receiving a wrapped gift.

senses.en: a polite way to show thanks

ex.en: Thank you for the lovely birthday card.
ex.zh: 谢谢你送的美好生日贺卡。

ex.en: 'Thank you very much,' she said with a smile.
ex.zh: “非常感谢。”她笑着说。

tip: thank you very much 是“非常感谢”；口语常说 thanks。
scene: A girl smiling and saying thank you as she receives a card.

senses.en: used before a noun when it is clear which one

ex.en: The sun is shining today.
ex.zh: 今天阳光明媚。

ex.en: Close the door, please.
ex.zh: 请关上门。

tip: the 用在特指的名词前；元音音素前读 /ðiː/。
scene: A bright sun shining over a house with an open door.

senses.en: belonging to them

ex.en: The children left their bags in the classroom.
ex.zh: 孩子们把书包落在教室里了。

ex.en: Their house is next to the river.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在河边。

tip: their 是形容词性物主代词；theirs 是名词性物主代词。
scene: Two school bags left on hooks in an empty classroom.

senses.en: the people or things already mentioned, as objects

ex.en: I called them yesterday evening.
ex.zh: 我昨晚给他们打了电话。

ex.en: Please give the books to them.
ex.zh: 请把书给他们。

tip: them 是 they 的宾格，作宾语用。
scene: A person handing a stack of books to two children.

senses.en: used when people do something to themselves

ex.en: They made the dinner themselves.
ex.zh: 晚餐是他们自己做的。

ex.en: The children enjoyed themselves at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子们在聚会上玩得很开心。

tip: by themselves 表示“独自”；enjoy oneself 是“玩得开心”。
scene: Children laughing and enjoying themselves at a birthday party.

senses.en: next in time; at that time

ex.en: First we had breakfast, then we went out.
ex.zh: 我们先吃早饭，然后出门。

ex.en: I was at school then.
ex.zh: 那时我在上学。

tip: then 表示顺序“然后”或时间“那时”。
scene: A breakfast table then a front door, showing morning steps in order.

senses.en: the thing or person here or now

ex.en: This is my favourite book.
ex.zh: 这是我最喜欢的书。

ex.en: This cake tastes wonderful.
ex.zh: 这个蛋糕尝起来很美味。

tip: this 指近处/当前的事物；that 指远处。复数 these。
scene: A hand holding up a colourful book, saying this is my favourite.

senses.en: plural of that; things further away

ex.en: Those apples look fresh.
ex.zh: 那些苹果看起来新鲜。

ex.en: Those are my friends over there.
ex.zh: 那边那些是我的朋友。

tip: those 是 that 的复数，指远处的人或物。
scene: A fruit stand with apples, a hand pointing at the ones further away.

senses.en: to make a place clean and neat

ex.en: Please tidy up your room before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前请整理好你的房间。

ex.en: We tidied up the classroom after the party.
ex.zh: 聚会后我们收拾了教室。

tip: tidy up 是“收拾整理”；tidy 是形容词“整洁的”。
scene: A child putting toys into a box to tidy up a bedroom.

senses.en: thin clothes covering the legs worn by women or children

ex.en: She wore red tights with her dress.
ex.zh: 她穿着红色连裤袜配连衣裙。

ex.en: A pair of tights is in the laundry basket.
ex.zh: 洗衣篮里有一条连裤袜。

col: a pair of tights｜一条连裤袜
tip: tights 常用复数；一条说 a pair of tights。
scene: A pair of red tights hanging over a chair in a bedroom.

senses.en: used for direction, receiving, or with verbs

ex.en: We walked to the park.
ex.zh: 我们走到公园。

ex.en: I want to learn English.
ex.zh: 我想学英语。

tip: to 表方向“到…”；也用于动词不定式 to do。
scene: A path leading from houses to a green park.

senses.en: a person who shows tourists around a place

ex.en: The tour guide showed us around the old town.
ex.zh: 导游带我们游览了老城。

ex.en: Our tour guide speaks three languages.
ex.zh: 我们的导游会说三种语言。

tip: tour guide 是带游客参观的导游。
scene: A tour guide with a flag leading tourists through an old town.

senses.en: an office where tourists get maps and advice

ex.en: We got a city map at the tourist information centre.
ex.zh: 我们在游客信息中心拿到了一张城市地图。

ex.en: The tourist information centre is open every day.
ex.zh: 游客信息中心每天开放。

tip: 游客信息中心提供地图、路线建议等服务。
scene: A tourist information centre with an i sign and a visitor getting a map.

senses.en: a signal with red, yellow and green lights for traffic

ex.en: Stop at the traffic light and wait for green.
ex.zh: 在红绿灯前停下，等绿灯。

ex.en: The traffic light turned red just as we arrived.
ex.zh: 我们到的时候红绿灯刚变红。

tip: traffic light 红绿灯；green light 绿灯通行，red light 红灯停。
scene: A traffic light showing green above a busy crossing.

senses.en: to put on clothes to see if they fit

ex.en: Can I try on this jacket, please?
ex.zh: 请问我可以试穿这件夹克吗？

ex.en: She tried on three dresses before choosing one.
ex.zh: 她试了三件裙子才选了一件。

tip: try on 是“试穿”；try it on 中代词放中间。
scene: A girl trying on a jacket in front of a shop mirror.

senses.en: to stop a machine or light working

ex.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
ex.zh: 离开时请关灯。

ex.en: He turned off the TV and went to bed.
ex.zh: 他关掉电视上床睡觉。

tip: turn off 与 switch off 同义；反义 turn on。
scene: A hand switching off a lamp in a bedroom.

senses.en: to make a machine or light start working

ex.en: Turn on the radio, please.
ex.zh: 请打开收音机。

ex.en: She turned on the computer and began to work.
ex.zh: 她打开电脑开始工作。

tip: turn on 是“打开”；反义 turn off 是“关掉”。
scene: A hand turning on a radio on a kitchen counter.

senses.en: the people speaking, as objects

ex.en: Our teacher told us an interesting story.
ex.zh: 老师给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

ex.en: Come with us to the cinema.
ex.zh: 和我们一起去看电影吧。

tip: us 是 we 的宾格，作宾语。
scene: Two friends inviting another to join them walking to a cinema.

senses.en: a game played on a screen or computer

ex.en: He plays video games for an hour after school.
ex.zh: 他放学后玩一小时电子游戏。

ex.en: This video game is popular with children.
ex.zh: 这款电子游戏很受孩子们欢迎。

tip: video game 是电子/视频游戏；play a video game 玩游戏。
scene: A child playing a video game with a controller in a living room.

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping

ex.en: I wake up at six thirty on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我六点半醒来。

ex.en: Please wake me up at seven tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天七点请叫醒我。

tip: wake up 是“醒来”；叫醒某人说 wake sb up。
scene: Sunlight coming through curtains as a child wakes up in bed.

senses.en: to wash the dishes, or wash yourself

ex.en: After dinner, we wash up the plates.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们洗盘子。

ex.en: He washed up before lunch.
ex.zh: 他午饭前洗了手脸。

tip: 英式 wash up 是“洗碗”；美式 wash up 是“洗手洗脸”。
scene: Hands washing plates in a kitchen sink with soap bubbles.

senses.en: a machine that washes clothes

ex.en: The washing machine is making a strange noise.
ex.zh: 洗衣机发出奇怪的声音。

ex.en: She put the dirty clothes into the washing machine.
ex.zh: 她把脏衣服放进洗衣机。

tip: washing machine 是洗衣机；do the washing 是洗衣服。
scene: A white washing machine in a laundry room with clothes going in.

senses.en: the job of washing the dishes

ex.en: It's your turn to do the washing-up tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚轮到你洗碗了。

ex.en: The washing-up is done and the kitchen is clean.
ex.zh: 碗洗完了，厨房很干净。

tip: do the washing-up 是“洗碗”的英式说法。
scene: Clean dishes drying on a rack above a kitchen sink.

senses.en: the speaker and other people

ex.en: We are going on holiday next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周去度假。

ex.en: We have English class on Monday.
ex.zh: 我们周一的英语课。

tip: we 是主格“我们”；宾格 us。
scene: Two children with backpacks walking towards a school gate.

senses.en: a page of information on the internet

ex.en: This web page has pictures of animals.
ex.zh: 这个网页有动物的图片。

ex.en: She found the information on a school web page.
ex.zh: 她在一个学校网页上找到了信息。

tip: web page 是网页；website 是网站（由多个网页组成）。
scene: A laptop screen showing a colourful web page about animals.

senses.en: in a good way; also used to start a sentence

ex.en: She sings very well.
ex.zh: 她唱歌唱得很好。

ex.en: Well, let's start the lesson.
ex.zh: 好了，我们开始上课吧。

tip: well 作副词“很好地”；作感叹词引出话题。
scene: A teacher clapping and saying well done to a student.

senses.en: known by many people

ex.en: This is a well-known restaurant in the city.
ex.zh: 这是城里一家著名的餐厅。

ex.en: She is well known for her cooking.
ex.zh: 她以厨艺闻名。

tip: well known 是“著名的”；be well known for 因…而闻名。
scene: A famous restaurant with people queuing outside a lit entrance.

senses.en: used in questions about things

ex.en: What is your name?
ex.zh: 你叫什么名字？

ex.en: What do you want for breakfast?
ex.zh: 早餐你想吃什么？

tip: what 用于提问事物；What's this? 这是什么？
scene: A child asking what with a hand raised in class.

senses.en: in or to which place

ex.en: Where do you live?
ex.zh: 你住在哪里？

ex.en: Do you know where the library is?
ex.zh: 你知道图书馆在哪里吗？

tip: where 用于询问地点。
scene: A tourist looking at a map and asking where a place is.

senses.en: during the time that; but

ex.en: She listened to music while she did her homework.
ex.zh: 她做作业时听音乐。

ex.en: He likes tea while his sister likes coffee.
ex.zh: 他喜欢茶，而他妹妹喜欢咖啡。

tip: while 引导时间状语从句“当…时”；也表示对比“然而”。
scene: A girl doing homework at a desk with headphones on.

senses.en: used in questions about people

ex.en: Who is that girl over there?
ex.zh: 那边那个女孩是谁？

ex.en: Who helped you with the homework?
ex.zh: 谁帮你做作业了？

tip: who 用于询问人；Whose 是询问“谁的”。
scene: A child pointing at a girl across the playground and asking who she is.

senses.en: to do a job, or to function

ex.en: My father works in a hospital.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在医院工作。

ex.en: The lift is not working today.
ex.zh: 电梯今天不能用。

tip: work 作动词“工作/运转”，作名词“工作”；job 是可数名词“工作”。
scene: A nurse working at a hospital desk with a computer.

senses.en: to exercise, or to find the answer

ex.en: She works out at the gym three times a week.
ex.zh: 她每周去健身房锻炼三次。

ex.en: Can you work out the answer to this problem?
ex.zh: 你能算出这道题的答案吗？

tip: work out 有“锻炼、算出、解决”等多个意思。
scene: A person exercising on a treadmill at a gym.

senses.en: the time when people work

ex.en: The shop's working hours are nine to six.
ex.zh: 这家店的工作时间是九点到六点。

ex.en: Please call us during working hours.
ex.zh: 请在上班时间给我们打电话。

tip: working hours 是工作时间，即上班时段。
scene: An office clock showing working hours with a schedule on the wall.

senses.en: used to ask politely or talk about habits

ex.en: Would you like some tea?
ex.zh: 你想喝点茶吗？

ex.en: When I was young, I would play here every day.
ex.zh: 小时候我每天都会在这里玩。

tip: would like 是“想要”的礼貌说法；Would you like...? 是邀请。
scene: A host offering a cup of tea to a guest with a smile.

senses.en: used to show surprise or admiration

ex.en: Wow! What a beautiful painting!
ex.zh: 哇！多漂亮的画啊！

ex.en: Wow, that's a great idea!
ex.zh: 哇，那是个好主意！

tip: wow 是表示惊叹的语气词。
scene: A child looking amazed at a colourful painting on an easel.

senses.en: to write something on paper so you remember it

ex.en: Write down the new words in your notebook.
ex.zh: 把新单词记在笔记本上。

ex.en: I wrote down her phone number.
ex.zh: 我记下了她的电话号码。

tip: write down 是“写下”；write it down 中代词放中间。
scene: A student writing new words in a notebook at a desk.

senses.en: used to agree or say something is true

ex.en: 'Are you ready?' 'Yes, I am.'
ex.zh: “你准备好了吗？”“是的。”

ex.en: Yes, I would love to come to your party.
ex.zh: 好的，我很乐意来参加你的聚会。

tip: yes 用于肯定回答；口语 yes please 表示同意并接受。
scene: A child nodding and saying yes with a big smile.

senses.en: the person or people spoken to

ex.en: You are my best friend.
ex.zh: 你是我最好的朋友。

ex.en: Are you coming to the party?
ex.zh: 你来参加聚会吗？

tip: you 单复数同形；you 的形容词性物主代词是 your。
scene: Two friends talking face to face on a sunny path.

senses.en: something that belongs to you

ex.en: This seat is yours.
ex.zh: 这个座位是你的。

ex.en: My umbrella is red; yours is black.
ex.zh: 我的伞是红色的，你的是黑色的。

tip: yours 是名词性物主代词；yours sincerely 是信件结尾敬语。
scene: A red umbrella and a black umbrella standing side by side by a door.

senses.en: a place where animals are kept for people to see

ex.en: We saw lions and monkeys at the zoo.
ex.zh: 我们在动物园看到了狮子和猴子。

ex.en: The zoo is closed on Mondays.
ex.zh: 动物园周一闭园。

tip: zoo 是动物园；go to the zoo 去动物园。
scene: A zoo entrance with a lion enclosure and children looking in.
